confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_03) who used a legitimate-looking ticket to gain access to finance directories, followed by a multi-day pattern of reading and downloading sensitive files from multiple departments (Finance and Engineering) that are outside their HR baseline, culminating in the transmission of files via email.

attack_chain.description: User_03 obtains read access to the finance reports directory using a ticket (HR-2026-441) for 'Annual review preparation'.
User_03 begins exploring cross-departmental data by reading finance files.
User_03 transitions from reading to downloading sensitive finance data (vendor_payments.xlsx).
User_03 expands scope to the engineering department, reading hiring files.
User_03 sends an email with an attachment, potentially exfiltrating the downloaded engineering template.
User_03 continues the pattern on a new day, downloading HR salary bands.
User_03 performs bulk downloads of finance and engineering files across multiple days.
User_03 sends multiple emails with attachments, likely exfiltrating the collected sensitive data.

gaps: Content of the sent emails to confirm if they contained the downloaded files.
Recipient email addresses for the sent mail events.
Verification of the validity of ticket HR-2026-441.
narrative: User_03 (HR) leveraged a privilege change to access finance directories and subsequently expanded their scope to include engineering data. Over a three-day period, the user exhibited a pattern of reading and downloading sensitive files from multiple departments, followed by sending emails with attachments, indicating a premeditated insider data exfiltration incident.
